Looking at this data, I need to:
1. Filter transactions from 2024-05-26 to 2024-07-17 inclusive
2. Apply corrections (using last occurrence of duplicate IDs)
3. Calculate net USD amount per customer (paid/settled adds, refunded/chargeback subtracts, pending/on hold ignored)
4. Convert EUR to USD at 1.069 rate

Let me create a systematic analysis:

from datetime import datetime

# Transaction data with corrections applied (last occurrence of duplicate IDs)
transactions = [
    ("T1002", "2024-06-22", "Cobalt", 92.67, "EUR", "paid"),
    ("T1003", "2024-06-14", "Acme", 1790.79, "USD", "PAID"),
    ("T1006", "2024-06-22", "Cobalt", 954.98, "EUR", "settled"),
    ("T1008", "2024-07-07", "Garnet", 2580.43, "EUR", "chargeback"),
    ("T1009", "2024-07-09", "Fjord", 3043.96, "USD", "REFUND"),
    ("T1012", "2024-06-23", "Cobalt", 4619.10, "EUR", "paid"),
    ("T1015", "2024-07-02", "Birch", 2513.87, "USD", "settled"),
    ("T1023", "2024-07-16", "Delta", 3327.90, "USD", "settled"),
    ("T1025", "2024-06-24", "Delta", 480.52, "USD", "paid"),
    ("T1034", "2024-07-12", "Fjord", 475.17, "EUR", "paid"),
    ("T1038", "2024-05-26", "Fjord", 2426.43, "EUR", "on hold"),
    ("T1040", "2024-06-30", "Garnet", 240.98, "USD", "settled"),
    ("T1042", "2024-05-31", "Garnet", 3911.08, "USD", "on hold"),
    ("T1046", "2024-05-28", "Cobalt", 2463.74, "USD", "PAID"),
    ("T1047", "2024-06-26", "Fjord", 2546.47, "USD", "paid"),
    ("T1048", "2024-06-11", "Cobalt", 112.85, "USD", "settled"),
    ("T1051", "2024-06-14", "Garnet", 1713.45, "USD", "settled"),
    ("T1053", "2024-07-09", "Cobalt", 887.53, "EUR", "settled"),
    ("T1054", "2024-07-04", "Delta", 3287.94, "EUR", "PAID"),
    ("T1057", "2024-06-24", "Cobalt", 4468.65, "USD", "refunded"),  # Corrected
    ("T1059", "2024-06-30", "Birch", 138.86, "USD", "settled"),
    ("T1060", "2024-07-13", "Ember", 4551.69, "EUR", "refunded"),
    ("T1064", "2024-06-28", "Fjord", 2258.56, "USD", "settled"),
    ("T1066", "2024-07-03", "Ember", 3737.91, "USD", "on hold"),  # Corrected
    ("T1067", "2024-06-05", "Delta", 121.80, "USD", "on hold"),
    ("T1070", "2024-06-10", "Cobalt", 3238.74, "USD", "pending"),
]

EUR_TO_USD = 1.069
START_DATE = datetime.strptime("2024-05-26", "%Y-%m-%d")
END_DATE = datetime.strptime("2024-07-17", "%Y-%m-%d")

# Status mapping
PAID_STATUSES = {'paid', 'PAID', 'settled'}
REFUNDED_STATUSES = {'refunded', 'REFUND', 'chargeback'}
IGNORED_STATUSES = {'pending', 'on hold'}

# Filter and process
net_by_customer = {}
for tid, date_str, customer, amount, currency, status in transactions:
    date = datetime.strptime(date_str, "%Y-%m-%d")
    
    # Check date range
    if not (START_DATE <= date <= END_DATE):
        continue
    
    # Check status
    if status in IGNORED_STATUSES:
        continue
    
    # Convert to USD
    if currency == "EUR":
        usd_amount = amount * EUR_TO_USD
    else:
        usd_amount = amount
    
    # Apply sign based on status
    if status in PAID_STATUSES:
        signed_amount = usd_amount
    elif status in REFUNDED_STATUSES:
        signed_amount = -usd_amount
    else:
        continue
    
    # Add to customer total
    if customer not in net_by_customer:
        net_by_customer[customer] = 0
    net_by_customer[customer] += signed_amount
    
    print(f"{tid} | {date_str} | {customer} | {amount} {currency} | {status} → ${signed_amount:,.2f}")

print("\n" + "="*60)
print("NET AMOUNTS BY CUSTOMER:")
print("="*60)

sorted_customers = sorted(net_by_customer.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
for customer, net in sorted_customers:
    print(f"{customer:15} ${net:>12,.2f}")

print("\n" + "="*60)
print(f"HIGHEST: {sorted_customers[0][0]} with ${sorted_customers[0][1]:,.2f}")
EOF
